purpose: Public security posture contract for Moral Trade headers, session boundaries, provider encryption assumptions, secret/key management, abuse throttling, and scale gates.

controls.label: HSTS, CSP, and browser security headers
controls.evidence: next.config.ts sets HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and CSP report-only headers.
controls.publicClaim: Security headers are configured at the app edge; CSP is currently report-only.

controls.label: Private no-store cache policy
controls.evidence: next.config.ts and background privacy controls mark dashboard, admin, profile, and job API routes private no-store.
controls.publicClaim: Authenticated and sensitive routes should not be cached as public pages.

controls.label: Supabase auth cookies
controls.evidence: src/lib/supabase/proxy.ts and src/lib/supabase/server.ts refresh auth through server-side cookies.

controls.label: Provider encryption at rest
controls.evidence: Supabase, Vercel, Stripe, Every.org, and email providers are treated as processor/provider boundaries; Moral Trade does not claim custom field-level encryption for every table.
controls.publicClaim: Encryption-at-rest is a provider-boundary control unless a field-level encryption control is explicitly published.

controls.label: Field-level encryption is not claimed
controls.evidence: background-privacy-controls marks field-encryption work as tracked separately.
controls.publicClaim: Private wishes and source notes are protected by access, redaction, cache, and consent controls; field-level encryption is not advertised as complete.

controls.label: Server-only secret management
controls.evidence: API integrations use server-side environment variables and public contracts avoid publishing secret values.
controls.publicClaim: Secrets must stay in deployment/provider secret stores and never be copied into public docs or client bundles.

controls.label: 2FA/MFA admin gate
controls.evidence: The public pilot does not claim verified 2FA enforcement for all sensitive admin users.
controls.publicClaim: Sensitive admin scale requires verified MFA/2FA enforcement before expansion.

controls.label: Device/session review gate
controls.evidence: The public pilot does not yet publish device inventory, session revocation, or anomalous-session review evidence.
controls.publicClaim: Sensitive admin scale requires a device/session review and revocation procedure.

controls.label: Key rotation gate
controls.evidence: The public pilot does not yet publish a Moral Trade-specific key rotation cadence for every provider secret.
controls.publicClaim: Paid-action or trust-badge scale requires provider secret/key rotation records and rollback notes.

controls.label: Platform abuse throttling
controls.evidence: Core signup, login, offer creation, comments, privacy requests, public contract reads, private advisory evaluations, wish search, profile portability, and analytics ingest have named rate-limit surfaces.
controls.publicClaim: Abuse-prone surfaces are rate-limited and must fail safely.

controls.label: Incident response reporting
controls.evidence: config/moral-trade/incident-response-profile.json and /api/moral-trade/incident-response/health publish intake, severity, disclosure, response-phase, and readiness-gate checks.
controls.publicClaim: Incident intake, response phases, public aggregate disclosure rules, and non-claims are validator-backed; this does not complete MFA, key rotation, device/session review, or field-level encryption.

scaleGates.label: Sensitive admin scale
scaleGates.rule: Do not expand sensitive admin access until MFA, device/session review, key rotation, and incident-response evidence are ready.

scaleGates.label: Paid-action volume scale
scaleGates.rule: Do not expand paid-action volume until provider/security boundaries, key rotation, incident response, and abuse throttles are documented.

scaleGates.label: Trust badge scale
scaleGates.rule: Do not expand public trust badges unless private cache, authenticated session, abuse throttling, and incident reporting remain verifiable.

publicNonClaims: Moral Trade does not claim custom field-level encryption for all private wish/source-note rows.
Moral Trade does not claim verified MFA/2FA enforcement for every sensitive admin user until the admin gate passes.
Moral Trade does not claim a completed key-rotation program until provider rotation records are published.
Moral Trade does not claim 24/7 staffed security operations or zero incidents; incident summaries stay aggregate and privacy-redacted.
Moral Trade does not claim zero security risk; public health endpoints expose blockers instead.
